faq.q: Is Titanium VCR Micro-Gasket compatible with fluorine-based process chemistries?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti has excellent resistance to NF₃, CF₄, SF₆, and other fluorine-based plasma chemistries used in semiconductor etching and chamber cleaning. The TiO₂ passive layer forms a stable TiF₄ reaction product that does not spall or generate particles. However, Titanium VCR Micro-Gasket should not be used in HF-containing wet processes where corrosion rates exceed 0.5 mm/year.
